narrative.text:
ENCOUNTER:
On February 19, 2024, at approximately 0610 hours, Agents [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] and [REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] encountered two men walking along a railroad line near Niles, Michigan. Both stated that they are citizens of Mexico without documents. This record concerns one of the two men.
ENTRY:
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he crossed the border near Nogales, Arizona, in 2016 by walking through the hills.
[REDACTED (b)(6), (b)(7)(C)] stated that he has been in the United States for about five years.
REMOVABILITY:
The subject is inadmissible under Section 212(a)(6)(A)(i) of the Immigration and Nationality Act, in that he is an alien present in the United States without being admitted or paroled.
DISPOSITION:
Both men were processed for Notices to Appear.
